auth

sections · 0.2.0 · aj-s-auth

The plain-paper open spread of sign in and create account: a canvas holding the account sheet, which lays two sides next to each other: the context (a large handwritten title, a line of copy and the three ways the journal is used) and the region holding the form. Below 700px of container the sides stack, the region first, and the ways are dropped.
